features.feature: Per-host launcher readiness rows (launcher argv, executionReady, reviewReady, progressMode, failureKind, firstProgressMs/durationMs) in review_host_availability_probe
reviewReadyHostCount derived only from row-level reviewReady=true; contradictory/forged counts rejected
No raw provider transcripts, tokens, or auth-profile contents persisted in probe evidence
available=true but executionReady=false with specific failureKind when launcher/auth fails despite versionOk
Non-human degraded fallback consumes reviewReadyHostCount/executionReadyHostCount instead of availableHostCount
Refuse single-host-environment / temporary-host-unavailability fallback when >=2 hosts are review-ready, even against prose evidenceRefs
Legacy B-7438 version-only probe events not eligible as review-ready proof; diagnostics direct rerun or explicit-human-approval
Fallback diagnostics name concrete causes (auth, wrong_launcher, timeout, silent-final-output)
Explicit-human-approval path preserved as lower-assurance alternative
Claude observable reviewer launcher modeled as claude --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json; plain --print classified silent/non-progress
agy --prompt-file classified wrong_launcher; canonical agy launcher --print + --print-timeout
Codex version/login success without codex exec success (token_invalidated/refresh_token_invalidated) classified as auth failure, not review-ready
Process-fact schema/registry updated and verify-process-fact-contract passes for gate-consumed readiness fields
Retired completion fields (authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone) remain false; local host evidence not promoted to release readiness
Probes stay bounded; no expensive long live LLM calls in routine paths

features.excluded_by: Background marks it explicitly optional; canonical launcher contract is --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json, and no checklist/plan artifact promises hook-event support
